_doc: THE SOAK REGISTER (SOAKCHAIN Car 4; DESIGN_HORIZON §1.6, §4.1). The home the 300-year
curve the tuning sitting signs against is frozen in — 'the re-run must plateau, not
explode slower'. Written ONLY by scripts/soak/soak-register.mjs --write, on a CLEAN tree,
from a receipt that passed with zero deterministic tripwire firings.
⛔ BOTH CELLS ARE UNFROZEN GENESIS. They carry no figures because NO LEDGER FIGURE IS
EVER TYPED IN — 're-measure, do not inherit'. The FIRST clean run is the freeze act, and
until it happens `--compare` reports NOT-EXECUTABLE and exits 0 with a proposal beside it.
⛔ CI NEVER WRITES THIS FILE. The research workflow runs `--compare … --propose` and
uploads the proposal; the chair mints it on a clean tree.
⛔⛔ THE GOVERNED GROWTH DOOR ⟦A22 E6⟧⟦CHAIR-R6⟧. Raising a `shrink` figure or lowering a
`floor` figure is refused even when declared, unless the write carries --charter=§NNN AND
a SOAK_REGISTER_NOTE of at least 60 characters; every such move appends a debtHistory row
and joins a shrink-only population every later --compare prints as a HOLD line.
SOAK-4's 'accept the honest red' is the ONLY sanctioned use before the sitting.

research-lit-4s/research-lit-4s-300y-4s-.note: UNFROZEN GENESIS. The INTERIM cell: 300 years x 4 settlements under the lit overlay, sized to fit a hosted 6-hour job (~2.3 h at the 3.5 s/settlement-year estimate — §14 E12 is deliberately left PLAUSIBLE, because two measured 30-year figures disagree by 17.8x at the same horizon and extrapolating either to 300 years is unsound). A DIFFERENT register identity from the 12 s cell, never a substitute for it.

research-lit/research-lit-300y-12s-seed1.note: UNFROZEN GENESIS. THE cell the tuning sitting signs against: 300 years x 12 settlements under the lit overlay. Its frozenAtSha and identity.lighting together are the citation the tuning signature record carries. Does not fit a hosted runner (~7 h before superlinearity) — SOAK-1 resolved to MANUAL, so the figure is produced on this Mac and minted through the same --write ritual; the register cares only that the tree was clean and the identity matches.
